expCards.title: Developing applications
responsibilities: Hospital App: Built a Flutter/Laravel management app for patient registration and doctor scheduling.
Social Media Backend: Developed a PHP/Laravel server using MVC architecture to manage platform data.
Database Management: Used MySQL for secure relational records and MongoDB for unstructured JSON posts.
Security & Logic: Implemented role-based authentication and custom controllers to route user data securely.

expCards.title: Developing artificial intelligence applications
responsibilities: Model Training & Deployment: Engineered and trained machine learning models using frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Data Pipeline Engineering: Built scalable data pipelines to clean, preprocess, and structure large datasets for model training.
API Integration: Developed and integrated RESTful APIs to connect AI model outputs into web and mobile applications.
Performance Optimization: Optimized model inference speeds and accuracy through hyperparameter tuning and model pruning.
